reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
The growth of advertising has brought several negative consequences for individuals, these harmful effects can be minimized through appropriate government intervention. However, I believe that these negative impacts can be mitigated through stricter government regulations.

The growth of advertising can lead to wasteful consumption and cause considerable annoyance. Persuasive advertisements entice consumers into buying products they may not otherwise need. This tendency is reinforced by celebrity endorsements, as celebrities’ social influence makes promoted products more trustworthy and desirable, encouraging impulsive spending. Moreover, constant exposure to advertising fosters materialistic values. By repeatedly associating products with comfort and happiness, advertisements subconsciously convince people that purchasing more goods will improve their quality of life. This creates a vicious cycle in which consumers continually pursue new goals and more expensive possessions, undermining spiritual values. Another problem is that excessive advertising causes annoyance. Social media users, for example, often complain about being bombarded with pop-up advertisements that interrupt their online activities, such as gaming or watching films.

To address these problems, governments should introduce stricter advertising regulations. Firstly, rigorous content checks should be conducted before advertisements are released to ensure that product descriptions accurately reflect their actual quality and that misleading claims are eliminated. This would protect consumers from deceptive marketing. Secondly, governments should restrict the number of platforms on which companies can advertise their products. This measure would reduce consumers’ exposure to excessive promotional messages, minimize online interruptions and discourage unnecessary purchases.

In conclusion, advertising can promote wasteful consumption, materialism and annoyance. Nevertheless, stricter content regulations and restrictions on advertising platforms could significantly mitigate these harmful effects.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them In my opinion, the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits, as their positive effects can be achieved through other activities.

On the one hand, video games offer several benefits. Firstly, they provide entertainment by allowing players to enter a virtual world and experience activities that are impossible or dangerous in real life. Secondly, many games require players to develop strategies to overcome challenges, which can improve their problem-solving, teamwork and decision-making skills. Nevertheless, these benefits can also be obtained through healthier alternatives. For example, participating in team sports or joining debate clubs can develop similar abilities while encouraging physical activity and social interaction.

On the other hand, the major drawback of video games is their addictive nature. Many games use scores, new targets and frequent rewards to create a sense of achievement, encouraging players to continue playing for extended periods. As a result, children may spend hours progressing through game levels or competing with their friends for higher scores. This excessive gaming can lead to sleep deprivation, deteriorating eyesight and a sedentary lifestyle. Furthermore, students who prioritise gaming over homework may struggle academically and achieve lower grades at school.

In conclusion, although video games provide entertainment and help players develop useful skills, these benefits can be gained through other activities. In contrast, gaming addiction can have lasting negative effects on both physical health and academic performance. Therefore, I believe that the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits.

Tuy nhiên, Body 1 chưa nối trải nghiệm trong thế giới ảo với cảm giác mới lạ, hào hứng; phần hoạt động thay thế cũng chưa nói rõ nguy cơ nghiện được tránh. reviews.suggestedRevision:
Although video games can be entertaining and may help players learn useful skills, I am firmly convinced that their drawbacks are more significant because these gains can be obtained through healthier activities.

On the one hand, video games offer some recreational and educational benefits. Firstly, players are transported into virtual worlds where they can, for example, race at speeds that would be dangerous in real life. These experiences offer a sense of novelty and excitement that few real-life pastimes can provide. Secondly, many games require players to develop strategies to win, which can improve their problem-solving, teamwork and decision-making skills. Nevertheless, these benefits can also be obtained through healthier alternatives. For example, team sports or debate clubs can develop similar abilities while encouraging physical activity and social interaction, without exposing young people to the same risks of addiction or physical inactivity.

On the other hand, I believe that the harmful effects of gaming are more serious because its addictive nature can affect both health and schoolwork. Players are given scores, new targets and frequent rewards, which can make them feel that they are achieving something and encourage them to keep playing. As a result, children may spend hours progressing through game levels or competing with their friends for higher scores. This excessive gaming can lead to sleep deprivation, deteriorating eyesight and a sedentary lifestyle. Furthermore, homework may be sacrificed for time on gaming consoles, so students may struggle academically and achieve lower grades at school.

In conclusion, although video games provide entertainment and help players develop useful skills, these benefits can be gained through other activities. Gaming addiction, by contrast, can have lasting negative effects on physical health and academic performance. Therefore, I believe that the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, people can access remote natural environments, such as the South Pole, which was previously difficult to reach. I believe this is a positive development because it offers tourists unique experiences and enables scientists to make important discoveries.

On the one hand, travelling to remote areas allows tourists to satisfy their curiosity and experience something new. Despite the numerous tourist attractions available worldwide, many travellers still seek unusual destinations. For example, visiting a little-known island allows them to participate in local religious practices, observe rare plants and animals, try unfamiliar food and experience a completely different way of life. Granted, some people argue that these experiences can be obtained by watching travel programmes on television. However, such programmes cannot provide the same level of excitement and personal involvement as exploring these places in person.

On the other hand, access to remote areas is highly beneficial to scientific research. Regardless of existing knowledge, many natural phenomena remain unexplored, particularly in isolated forests and deep underwater environments. By visiting these places, scientists can discover new viruses and investigate how global warming affects the lives and habitats of rare animals. A better understanding of these issues can help humanity prepare for potential disease outbreaks that could threaten millions of lives. Furthermore, scientific research can contribute to restoring damaged habitats and protecting endangered species.

In conclusion, I consider the increasing accessibility of remote natural areas to be a positive development. Not only does it provide tourists with valuable and memorable experiences, but it also allows scientists to gain knowledge that can benefit both humans and the natural world.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đúng hướng có lợi, triển khai rõ lợi ích cho du khách và nhà khoa học, đồng thời phản biện được ý xem qua truyền hình. Ở đoạn khoa học, em cần nói rõ ví dụ virus mới có thể bùng phát từng đợt rồi nối với khả năng ứng phó; các phần còn lại của chuỗi lập luận đã có. criteria.action: Bổ sung sự bùng phát của virus mới vào chính câu ví dụ khoa học, rồi giữ câu về việc hiểu hiện tượng để chuẩn bị ứng phó.

criteria.title: Giải thích ý và phản biện
evidence: Despite the numerous tourist attractions available worldwide, many travellers still seek unusual destinations.
However, such programmes cannot provide the same level of excitement and personal involvement as exploring these places in person.
A better understanding of these issues can help humanity prepare for potential disease outbreaks that could threaten millions of lives.
criteria.comment: Em nối được nhu cầu trải nghiệm mới với ví dụ chuyến đi, nêu rõ vì sao xem truyền hình kém trải nghiệm trực tiếp, và nối nghiên cứu với khả năng chuẩn bị trước dịch bệnh.

criteria.title: Vận dụng từ vựng và cấu trúc đã học
evidence: these experiences can be obtained by watching travel programmes on television.
By visiting these places, scientists can discover new viruses and investigate how global warming affects the lives and habitats of rare animals.
criteria.comment: Em dùng đúng bị động “can be obtained” và cụm “By visiting these places” có cùng người thực hiện là scientists. Body 2 còn cơ hội diễn đạt đối tượng chịu tác động bằng bị động, như rare animals and their habitats are affected by global warming; đây là yêu cầu luyện tập, không phải lỗi ngữ pháp của câu gốc.
criteria.action: Viết lại một phần câu khoa học bằng bị động, giữ đúng tác nhân global warming và ý nghiên cứu của em.

criteria.title: Nối câu, nối đoạn và dùng từ thay thế
evidence: Granted, some people argue that these experiences can be obtained by watching travel programmes on television. However, such programmes cannot provide the same level of excitement and personal involvement as exploring these places in person.
A better understanding of these issues can help humanity prepare for potential disease outbreaks that could threaten millions of lives.
criteria.comment: Granted gắn ý đối lập với người khác, However nêu đúng điểm yếu của ý ấy; “such programmes” và “these issues” có nội dung trước đó để người đọc nhận ra.

criteria.title: Viết chính xác và tự soát bài
evidence: For example, visiting a little-known island allows them to participate in local religious practices, observe rare plants and animals, try unfamiliar food and experience a completely different way of life.
In conclusion, I consider the increasing accessibility of remote natural areas to be a positive development.
criteria.comment: Các câu được trích có chủ ngữ, động từ, cách liệt kê và dấu câu đúng; cả bài đủ 264 từ theo cách đếm của bài giao.

studentQuotes: I believe this is a positive development because it offers tourists unique experiences and enables scientists to make important discoveries.

outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 1: [LỢI CHO TOURISTS]

studentQuotes: Despite the numerous tourist attractions available worldwide, many travellers still seek unusual destinations.

For example, visiting a little-known island allows them to participate in local religious practices, observe rare plants and animals, try unfamiliar food and experience a completely different way of life.
outlineCoverage.comment: Có đủ nhu cầu mới lạ và ví dụ đảo ít người biết với phong tục, động thực vật, món ăn, lối sống khác.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: - no matter how many tourist attractions there are in the world - globetrotters all around the world still crave novelty → [ex] travel to an island that is unknown to the vast majority of people → travelers - have a chance to participate in exotic religious practices of indigenous people + feast their eyes on rarely seen plants and animals + try new food and experience a whole new way of life

studentQuotes: Granted, some people argue that these experiences can be obtained by watching travel programmes on television.
However, such programmes cannot provide the same level of excitement and personal involvement as exploring these places in person.
outlineCoverage.comment: Mượn lời ý xem truyền hình và phản biện bằng sự khác biệt của trải nghiệm trực tiếp.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [phản biện nhỏ để kéo dài đoạn - tránh bí ý thiếu từ và tạo điểm nhấn tư duy cho bài luận] Granted, one might say that they can see these things on TV channels dedicated to travel. However, the experience is far inferior to experiencing such activities in person.

studentQuotes: On the other hand, access to remote areas is highly beneficial to scientific research.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu chủ đề Body 2 nêu lợi ích chung cho nghiên cứu khoa học.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 2: [LỢI CHO SCIENTISTS]

studentQuotes: Regardless of existing knowledge, many natural phenomena remain unexplored, particularly in isolated forests and deep underwater environments.

outlineCoverage.comment: Có khoảng trống hiểu biết và vai trò của việc tiếp cận vùng xa trong tìm lời giải.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → regardless of how much we already know about the world - there is still much that is unknown in the field of science → visit such places - give scientists answers to many existing and future problems

studentQuotes: scientists can discover new viruses and investigate how global warming affects the lives and habitats of rare animals.
A better understanding of these issues can help humanity prepare for potential disease outbreaks that could threaten millions of lives.
Furthermore, scientific research can contribute to restoring damaged habitats and protecting endangered species.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em đã giữ ví dụ virus, tác động nóng lên toàn cầu, chuẩn bị ứng phó dịch bệnh và phục hồi môi trường sống. Cần nói rõ phần virus mới có thể bùng phát từng đợt; câu “discover new viruses” chưa diễn đạt hiện tượng ấy.
